title: PolyMarket
tagline: Polymarket allows you to bet on different game outcomes and gamifies user experience.
description:
Polymarket allows you to bet on different game outcomes. Bet on the future and get unbiased real-time forecasts on what matters most to you.
Polymarket is a decentralized prediction market platform that allows users to trade on the outcomes of real-world events, such as political elections, sports matches, and current events. Users can buy and sell shares in various outcomes using cryptocurrency, with the value of each share representing the likelihood of that outcome occurring.

The platform uses a peer-to-peer architecture, which means that users can interact directly with the platform without the need for intermediaries. This makes it easier for users to access the platform and trade on the outcomes of events without having to go through traditional financial institutions.

It is deployed on Scroll Testnet, Matic Mumbai Testnet.
how_its_made:
It is deployed on Scroll Testnet, Matic Mumbai Testnet.
